meta.title: Request for Best Offer in Auction: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Buyer user on a Growth tenant and verify whether Request for Best Offer is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Buyer in the same tenant and verify that it is available.
Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Buyer user on a Growth tenant and verify whether Request for Best Offer is refused or absent.; Repeat the action as a Buyer in the same tenant and verify that it is available.; Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan.

steps.note: Open an existing auction event suitable for checking the Request for Best Offer action.
Inspect whether the current user's auction Settings menu offers the action, without assuming the user's role.

args.need: Use the same Growth-tenant auction to sign in as a non-Buyer, check whether Request for Best Offer is absent or refused, then repeat as a Buyer and check that the action is available.

steps.note: Role-specific sign-in and comparison between the non-Buyer and Buyer are not available in the catalog.
Confirm the auction event page remains available after the tester's role comparison.
